name: map
description: Turns the key/value pairs of a `callEach` fetch into an object, so a mapping enumerated with known keys reads as `{ key: value }`. Exists because 71 V1 `call` handlers and the mapping enumerations in templates all end in this shape, and fixing it here keeps key rendering identical across plans. Replaces V1 `call` handlers with literal keys and template mapping enumerations.
input: The result of a `callEach` fetch: `[{ key, value }]` in key order, where `key` is the call argument (or the argument tuple) and `value` the decoded return value.
output: Object keyed by the string form of each `key` (numbers and booleans as their JSON text, tuples joined with `,`, e.g. `1,0`) holding the corresponding `value`, in input order. A key repeated in the input keeps its last value.
